title: Dummy
text: A low cross is coming to you, but a defender is right behind you. Your teammate is free just behind you.
tip: Sometimes the best touch is no touch.

options.text: Let it run through to your teammate (a dummy)
options.why: Your dummy fools the defender, and your teammate gets a free shot.

options.text: Try to control it with the defender on you
options.why: You might keep it, but the defender will be all over you.

options.text: Stop it and wait for help
options.why: The defender will nick it straight away.
